```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
#Spatial Visualization of gene
plot_spatial_gene <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    gene,
    x = "x",
    y = "y",
    pt_size = 0.15,
    title = NULL,
    expr_min = 0,
    expr_max = NULL
) {
  
  df <- FetchData(seurat_obj, vars = c(x, y, gene))
  colnames(df) <- c("x", "y", "expr")
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = expr)) +
    geom_point(size = pt_size) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "magma",
      limits = c(expr_min, expr_max),
      oob = scales::squish,
      breaks = pretty(c(expr_min, expr_max), n = 5),
      name = gene
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = ifelse(is.null(title), gene, title)
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold.italic"),
      legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold.italic"),
      legend.text  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
}
genes <- c("CPS1", "ASS1", "PCK1", "HAL")
expr_all <- FetchData(seurat_obj, vars = genes)

shared_max <- quantile(
  as.matrix(expr_all),
  probs = 0.99,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
#shared_max

p1 <- plot_spatial_gene(seurat_obj, "CPS1", expr_min = 0, expr_max = shared_max)
p2 <- plot_spatial_gene(seurat_obj, "ASS1", expr_min = 0, expr_max = shared_max)
p3 <- plot_spatial_gene(seurat_obj, "PCK1", expr_min = 0, expr_max = shared_max)
p4 <- plot_spatial_gene(seurat_obj, "HAL",  expr_min = 0, expr_max = shared_max)

final_plot <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) +
  
      theme(
         #title = "Periportal marker localization",
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 20,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )

final_plot
```

```{r}
plot_spatial_celltype <- function(seurat_obj, x="x", y="y", group="cell_type", pt_size=1.2) {
  df <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>% select(all_of(c(x,y,group)))
  colnames(df) <- c("x","y","celltype")
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color =celltype)) +
    geom_point(size = pt_size) +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_colors)+
    scale_y_reverse()+
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = "Cell types") 
 
  
}
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
#library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)

DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
hep <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_type == "Hepatocytes")
DefaultAssay(hep) <- "RNA"

############################################################
# 1. CREATE CV -> PV BINS
############################################################

# Your data:
# high zonation_pt = CV
# low zonation_pt  = PV

# Flip axis so:
# low = CV
# high = PV
#table(zonation)
seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv <-
  max(seurat_obj$zonation_pt, na.rm = TRUE) -
  seurat_obj$zonation_pt

n_bins <- 9

seurat_obj$zbin9 <- cut(
  seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv,
  breaks = seq(
    min(seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = n_bins + 1
  ),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = as.character(1:n_bins)
)
############################################################
# 2. GET TF EXPRESSION MATRIX
############################################################

mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")

# TF list already defined:
# tfs <- c(...)
tfs <- c("TCF7","AHR","FOXA2","NR1I3","PPARA","PPARD","PPARG","MLXIPL",
         "DBP","HLF","HNF4A","TEAD1","KLF15","ESRRA","PGC1A","BHLHE40",
         "NR1H3","SREBF1","NFIL3","TB1XR1","ATF2","CEBPA")
##If your regulon columns are named like AHR directly, use those.
#If named with suffix, set regulon_cols:


tfs_present <- intersect(tfs, rownames(mat))

tfs_present 
df_tf <- data.frame(
  bin = seurat_obj$zbin9,
  t(as.matrix(
    mat[tfs_present, colnames(seurat_obj), drop = FALSE]
  ))
)

df_tf$bin <- as.character(df_tf$bin)

############################################################
# 3. MEAN EXPRESSION PER BIN
############################################################

bin_means <- df_tf %>%
  filter(!is.na(bin)) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(tfs_present), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.integer(bin))

############################################################
# 4. MATRIX FOR HEATMAP
############################################################

mat_bin <- t(as.matrix(bin_means[, -1]))

# IMPORTANT:
# use only numeric labels 1..9
colnames(mat_bin) <- as.character(1:9)

############################################################
# 5. ROW-WISE MIN-MAX SCALING
############################################################

mat_mm <- t(
  apply(mat_bin, 1, function(v) {
    (v - min(v, na.rm = TRUE)) /
      (max(v, na.rm = TRUE) - min(v, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9)
  })
)

############################################################
# 6. LONG FORMAT FOR GGPLOT

) +
```

```{r}
make_zonation_heatmap_matrix <- function(seu,
                                         celltype = "Hepatocytes",
                                         #celltype = "Cholangiocytes",
                                         #celltype = "HSC",
                                         #celltype = "HSC",
                                         #celltype = "Kupffer cells",
                                         genes,
                                         n_bins = 9,
                                         #n_bins = 3,
                                         assay = "RNA",
                                         slot = "data",
                                         direction = c("CV_to_PV","PV_to_CV")) {
  
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- assay
  mat <- GetAssayData(seu, slot = slot)  # genes x cells
  
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(seu))
  if (length(genes) < 2) stop("Too few genes found in object.")
  meta <- seu@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(cell_type == celltype) %>%
    dplyr::select(zonation_pt)##cell_type == celltype
  
  
  cells <- rownames(meta)
  #if (length(cells) < 5) warning("Very few LSEC: ", length(cells))
  
  # make bins
  meta$bin <- cut(meta$zonation_pt,
                  breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1),
                  include.lowest = TRUE,
                  labels = FALSE)
  
  # mean expression per bin
  out <- sapply(1:n_bins, function(b){
    bcells <- cells[meta$bin == b]
    if (length(bcells) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(genes)))
    Matrix::rowMeans(mat[genes, bcells, drop = FALSE])
  })
  
  rownames(out) <- genes
  colnames(out) <- as.character(1:n_bins)
  
  # row-wise z-score (like "Min/Max" scale in figure)
  z <- t(scale(t(out)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  
  # set direction
  if (direction == "CV_to_PV") {
    # if your zonation_pt is PV(0)->CV(1), then CV_to_PV means reverse columns
    z <- z[, n_bins:1, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(z) <- as.character(n_bins:1)
  }
  
  return(z)
 
}
```

```{r}
## newfor spatial map contourupdated-05/14/2026
  plot_gene_spatial_contour <- function(
    seu,
    gene,
    x = "x",
    y = "y",
    assay = "RNA",
    slot = "data",
    grid_n = 400,          # MUCH higher resolution
    contour_quantile = 0.92,
    smooth_sigma = 2,
    title = NULL
  ){
    
    library(akima)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(scales)
    library(imager)
    
    DefaultAssay(seu) <- assay
    mat <- GetAssayData(seu, slot = slot)
    
    if (!gene %in% rownames(mat))
      stop(paste("Gene not found:", gene))
    
    df <- seu@meta.data %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(c(x, y))) %>%
      mutate(expr = as.numeric(mat[gene, rownames(seu@meta.data)])) %>%
      filter(is.finite(.data[[x]]),
             is.finite(.data[[y]]),
             is.finite(expr)) %>%
      rename(X = all_of(x),
             Y = all_of(y))
    
    # OPTIONAL: remove ultra-low noise
    thresh <- quantile(df$expr[df$expr > 0], 0.15, na.rm = TRUE)
    df$expr[df$expr < thresh] <- 0
    
    # Interpolation
    interp <- akima::interp(
      x = df$X,
      y = df$Y,
      z = df$expr,
      nx = grid_n,
      ny = grid_n,
      duplicate = "mean"
    )
    
    grid <- expand.grid(
      X = interp$x,
      Y = interp$y
    )
    
    grid$expr <- as.vector(interp$z)
    
    # Replace NAs
    grid$expr[is.na(grid$expr)] <- 0
    
    # ---- Gaussian smoothing ----
    mat_img <- matrix(grid$expr, nrow = grid_n, ncol = grid_n)
    
    img <- as.cimg(mat_img)
    
    img_s <- isoblur(img, sigma = smooth_sigma)
    
    smooth_vals <- as.vector(img_s)
    
    grid$expr_s <- rescale(
      smooth_vals,
      to = c(0,1),
      from = range(smooth_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    # Contour threshold
    thr <- quantile(grid$expr_s, contour_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
    p <- ggplot(grid, aes(X, Y)) +
      
      geom_raster(
        aes(fill = expr_s),
        interpolate = TRUE
      ) +
      
      geom_contour(
        aes(z = expr_s),
        breaks = c(thr),
        color = "white",
        linewidth = 0.7
      ) +
      
      coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
      
      scale_fill_gradient(
        low = "#2C105C",
        high = "#FDE725",
        name = "Exp\nMax\nMin"
      ) +
      
      theme_void(base_size = 11) +
      
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          hjust = 0.5,
          size = 12
        ),
        
        legend.position = "right",
        
        legend.title = element_text(
          ),
        
        legend.text = element_text(
          size = 10,
          ),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 40, 10)
      ) +
      
      labs(
        title = ifelse(is.null(title), gene, title)
      )
  }
```

```{r}
seurat_obj<-readRDS("seurat_objF_celltype_singleRanno_4815_all.rds")
# nonparenchymal cell type (cholangiocytes & Kupffer cells)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)

make_zonation_heatmap <- function(seu, celltype, genes,
                                  bin_width = 0.07,
                                  assay = "RNA",
                                  slot = "data",
                                  scale_by_gene = TRUE) {
  
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- assay
  mat <- GetAssayData(seu, slot = slot)  # genes x cells
  
  # keep genes that exist
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(seu))
  if (length(genes) < 2) stop("Too few genes found in the object for: ", celltype)
  
  # subset cells
  meta <- seu@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(cell_type == celltype) %>%
    dplyr::select(zonation_pt)
  
  cells <- rownames(meta)
  if (length(cells) < 10) warning("Very few cells for ", celltype, ": ", length(cells))
  
  # make zonation bins
  breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = bin_width)
  meta$z_bin <- cut(meta$zonation_pt, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  
  # expression for selected cells/genes
  expr <- t(as.matrix(mat[genes, cells, drop = FALSE]))  # cells x genes
  df <- cbind(meta, expr) %>% as.data.frame()
  
  # long format
  df_long <- df %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr")
  
  # average expression per bin per gene
  hm <- df_long %>%
    group_by(gene, z_bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_expr = mean(expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # optional: z-score per gene (recommended for heatmap look)
  if (scale_by_gene) {
    hm <- hm %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      mutate(value = as.numeric(scale(mean_expr))) %>%
      ungroup()
    fill_lab <- "Z-score"
  } else {
    hm$value <- hm$mean_expr
    fill_lab <- "Mean expr"
  }
  
  # ensure PV->CV order on x-axis
  hm$z_bin <- factor(hm$z_bin, levels = levels(meta$z_bin))
  
  p <- ggplot(hm, aes(x = z_bin, y = gene, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = fill_lab) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text()
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste0(celltype, ": marker genes along PV \u2192 CV"),
      x = "Portal \u2192 Pericentral",
      y = NULL
    )
  
  return(p)
}

)
```

```{r}
plot_spatial_continuous <- function(obj, feature, title=NULL, x="x", y="y", pt_size=1.0) {
  stopifnot(feature %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
  stopifnot(x %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
  stopifnot(y %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
  
  df <- obj@meta.data[, c(x, y, feature)]
  colnames(df) <- c("x","y","val")
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y, color=val)) +
    geom_point(size=pt_size) +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title=title, color=feature) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))
}
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(Matrix)

DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"


plot_spatial_gene <- function(seu, gene, pt_size=1.0, title=NULL){
  df <- FetchData(seu, vars=c("x","y",gene))
  colnames(df) <- c("x","y","expr")
  ggplot(df, aes(x,y,color=expr)) +
    geom_point(size=pt_size) +
    coord_fixed() +
    #scale_color_viridis_c(option="magma") +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option="viridis") +
    theme_void() +
    ggtitle(ifelse(is.null(title), gene, title)) +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
         hjust = 0.5
      ),
  
     legend.title = element_text(
    ),
  
   legend.text = element_text(
      )
)
}   
plot_zonation_tile <- function(seu, gene, n_bins=40, title=NULL){
  
  df <- FetchData(seu, vars=c("zonation_pt", gene)) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(zonation_pt))
  colnames(df) <- c("z","expr")
  
  breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1)
  df$zbin <- cut(df$z, breaks=breaks, include.lowest=TRUE)
  
  agg <- df |>
    group_by(zbin) |>
    summarise(val = mean(expr, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
  
  agg$x <- seq_len(nrow(agg))
  agg$y <- 1
  
  # Axis ticks
  x_breaks <- round(seq(1, nrow(agg), length.out=5))
  x_labels <- round(seq(0, 1, length.out=5), 2)
  
  ggplot(agg, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=val)) +
    geom_tile(height=0.9) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="magma", name="Expression") +
    #scale_fill_viridis_c(option="viridis", name="Expression") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = x_breaks,
      labels = x_labels
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
              ),
      
      legend.title = element_text(
        ),
      
      legend.text = element_text(
       
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        ),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Portal→Pericentral",
      title = ifelse(is.null(title), gene, title)
    )
}
```

```{r}
hep$zone3 <- cut(
  hep$zonation_cv2pv,
  breaks = quantile(
    hep$zonation_cv2pv,
    probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = c("CV","MZ","PV")
)

hep$zone3 <- factor(hep$zone3, levels = c("CV","MZ","PV"))
table(hep$zone3)
table(hep$zone3)
Idents(hep) <- "zone3"

deg_CV <- FindMarkers(hep, ident.1="CV", ident.2=c("MZ","PV"), logfc.threshold=0.25)
deg_MZ <- FindMarkers(hep, ident.1="MZ", ident.2=c("CV","PV"), logfc.threshold=0.25)

get_sig_genes <- function(deg, padj=0.05, topN=1000){
  deg <- deg[order(deg$p_val_adj, -abs(deg$avg_log2FC)), , drop=FALSE]
  g <- rownames(deg)[which(deg$p_val_adj < padj)]
  head(g, topN)
}

genes_CV <- get_sig_genes(deg_CV)
genes_MZ <- get_sig_genes(deg_MZ)
genes_PV <- get_sig_genes(deg_PV)
genes_CV
genes_PV

##Map gene symbols → Entrez IDs
to_entrez <- function(genes){
  bitr(genes, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Bt.eg.db) %>%
    distinct(SYMBOL, .keep_all=TRUE)
}

ent_CV <- to_entrez(genes_CV)

ent_CV
## Run enrichKEGG
ekegg <- function(entrez_ids){
  enrichKEGG(
    gene = entrez_ids,
    organism = "bta",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 0.3
  )
}

k_CV <- ekegg(ent_CV$ENTREZID)
k_MZ <- ekegg(ent_MZ$ENTREZID)
k_PV <- ekegg(ent_PV$ENTREZID)
##Build the CV/MZ/PV heatmap of −log10(q)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
kegg_df <- function(k, zone){
  if (is.null(k) || nrow(as.data.frame(k))==0) return(data.frame())
  as.data.frame(k) %>%
    transmute(
      Pathway = Description,
      q = qvalue,
      neglog10q = -log10(q),
      zone = zone
    )
}

df_all <- bind_rows(
  kegg_df(k_CV, "CV"),
  kegg_df(k_MZ, "MZ"),
  kegg_df(k_PV, "PV")
)

# choose pathways to display (top across all zones)
top_paths <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Pathway) %>%
  summarise(maxScore = max(neglog10q, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(maxScore)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 25) %>%          # change 20 to what you want
  pull(Pathway)
#Explicitly call dplyr::select() and tidyr::pivot_wider():
hm <- df_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Pathway %in% top_paths) %>%
  dplyr::select(Pathway, zone, neglog10q) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = zone,
    values_from = neglog10q,
    values_fill = 0
  )
hm_long <- hm %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c("CV","MZ","PV"),
    names_to = "Zone",
    values_to = "Score"
  )


#hm <- df_all %>%
# filter(Pathway %in% top_paths) %>%
# select(Pathway, zone, neglog10q) %>%
#pivot_wider(names_from = zone, values_from = neglog10q, values_fill = 0)

# long for ggplot
##hm_long <- hm %>%
##pivot_longer(cols = c("CV","MZ","PV"), names_to="Zone", values_to="Score") did not work

# keep pathway order like the figure (top enriched at bottom or top as you prefer)
hm_long$Pathway <- factor(hm_long$Pathway, levels = rev(top_paths))
hm_long$Zone <- factor(hm_long$Zone, levels=c("CV","MZ","PV"))
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
)
p <- ggplot(hm_long, aes(x=Zone, y=Pathway, fill=Score)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="firebrick",
                      name=expression(-log[10](Q~value))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(
    #axis.title = element_blank()
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 12,#14
      ),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle("HepatocytesKEGG enrichment")

print(p)
```

```{r}
## WGCNA analysis of stereo-seq liver  data 

library(Seurat)
library(WGCNA)
library(dplyr)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
enableWGCNAThreads()
hep <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_type == "Hepatocytes")
DefaultAssay(hep) <- "RNA"

periportal  <- list(c("CPS1","ASS1","HAL","PCK1"))
pericentral <- list(c("GLUL","CYP2E1","CYP1A2","AXIN2"))

hep <- AddModuleScore(hep, features = periportal,  name = "periportal")
hep <- AddModuleScore(hep, features = pericentral, name = "pericentral")

hep$zonation_axis <- hep$pericentral1 - hep$periportal1
hep$zonation_pt <- (hep$zonation_axis - min(hep$zonation_axis)) /
  (max(hep$zonation_axis) - min(hep$zonation_axis))
#hep$zonation_pt
##Use variable genes to reduce memory.
hep <- FindVariableFeatures(hep, nfeatures = 3000) ## hep
genes_use <- VariableFeatures(hep)
genes_use
datExpr <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(hep, slot = "data")[genes_use, ]))  # cells/spots x genes
datTraits <- data.frame(zonation_pt = hep$zonation_pt)
##Quality check:
gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr, verbose = 3)
if (!gsg$allOK) {
  datExpr <- datExpr[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes]
  datTraits <- datTraits[gsg$goodSamples, , drop = FALSE]
}
##3) Pick soft-threshold power (important)
powers <- 1:20
#sft <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr, powerVector = powers, verbose = 0)

# Choose one power (often 6–12 for signed networks)
softPower <- 8
#softPower <- 20
##4. Detect modules
adj <- adjacency(datExpr, power = softPower, type = "signed")
TOM <- TOMsimilarity(adj)
dissTOM <- 1 - TOM

geneTree <- hclust(as.dist(dissTOM), method = "average")
library(ggplot2)
minModuleSize <- 14
dynamicMods <- cutreeDynamic(
  dendro = geneTree, distM = dissTOM,
  deepSplit = 2, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  minClusterSize = minModuleSize
)
#datExpr
#hep@meta.data$
moduleColors <- labels2colors(dynamicMods)

# Plot dendrogram + colors (like your figure)
#P1 <- plotDendroAndColors(geneTree, moduleColors, "Module colors",
                   # dendroLabels = FALSE, hang = 0.03,
                    #addGuide = TRUE, guideHang = 0.05)
#P1

par(
  font.axis = 2,      # bold tick labels
  font.lab  = 2,      # bold axis label
  font.main = 2,      # bold title
  cex.axis = 1.0,     # y-axis tick size
  cex.lab  = 1.5,     # Height label size
  cex.main = 1.6,     # title size
  las = 1,            # horizontal y-axis tick labels
  mgp = c(4.2, 1.0, 0) # moves "Height" away from tick labels
)

plotDendroAndColors(
  geneTree,
  moduleColors,
  groupLabels = "Module colors",
  dendroLabels = FALSE,
  hang = 0.03,
  addGuide = TRUE,
  guideHang = 0.05,
  main = "Cluster Dendrogram",
  marAll = c(2, 8, 4, 2),
  colorHeight = 0.8,
  cex.colorLabels = 1.5,
  
)
```

```{r}
tca_genes   <- c("CS","ACO2","SDHA","FH")
keto_genes  <- c("HMGCS2","BDH1")
gng_genes   <- c("PCK1","G6PC")
urea_genes  <- c("ASS1","CPS1")

gene_sets <- list(
  "TCA cycle (CV)" = tca_genes,
  "Ketogenesis (CV)" = keto_genes,
  "Gluconeogenesis (PV)" = gng_genes,
  "Urea cycle (PV)" = urea_genes

##Build a genes × CV→PV bins matrix (mean expression per bin)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)

DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")  # log-normalized

# ✅ Correct direction: high=CV, low=PV  → make CV→PV axis low=CV, high=PV
seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv <- max(seurat_obj$zonation_pt, na.rm=TRUE) - seurat_obj$zonation_pt

n_bins <- 9
seurat_obj$zbin9 <- cut(
  seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv,
  breaks = seq(min(seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv, na.rm=TRUE),
               max(seurat_obj$zonation_cv2pv, na.rm=TRUE),
               length.out = n_bins + 1),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = as.character(1:n_bins)
)

# all genes (keep only those present)
genes_all <- unique(unlist(gene_sets))
genes_all <- intersect(genes_all, rownames(seurat_obj))
genes_all

##Create the mean-by-bin matrix:
cells_by_bin <- split(colnames(seurat_obj), seurat_obj$zbin9)

mean_by_bin <- sapply(names(cells_by_bin), function(b){
  cells <- cells_by_bin[[b]]
  if (length(cells) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(genes_all)))
  Matrix::rowMeans(mat[genes_all, cells, drop=FALSE])
})
rownames(mean_by_bin) <- genes_all
rownames(mean_by_bin)
colnames(mean_by_bin) <- paste0("Bin", names(cells_by_bin))  # Bin1..Bin9 (CV→PV)
##Row-scale (z-score per gene) for a nice heatmap:

zmat <- t(scale(t(mean_by_bin)))
zmat[is.na(zmat)] <- 0
##Make a pathway-ordered heatmap (with PV/CV direction labels)
#Create annotation table so genes are grouped by pathway:
gene2path <- bind_rows(lapply(names(gene_sets), function(p){
  tibble(Pathway = p, Gene = intersect(gene_sets[[p]], rownames(zmat)))
}))

# order genes by pathway (and within pathway keep your listed order)
gene_order <- gene2path %>%
  group_by(Pathway) %>%
  summarise(Gene = list(Gene), .groups="drop") %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unlist()

zmat2 <- zmat[gene_order, , drop=FALSE]
##Plot
hm_long <- as.data.frame(zmat2) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Bin"), names_to="Bin", values_to="Z") %>%
  left_join(gene2path, by="Gene")

hm_long$Bin <- factor(hm_long$Bin, levels = paste0("Bin", 1:9))
hm_long$Gene <- factor(hm_long$Gene, levels = rev(gene_order))
p <- ggplot(hm_long, aes(x=Bin, y=Gene, fill=Z)) +
  
  geom_tile() +
  
  facet_grid(Pathway ~ ., scales="free_y", space="free_y") +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low="#2166AC",
    mid="white",
    high="#B2182B",
    midpoint=0,
    name="Z-score"
  ) +
  
  # ✅ change Bin1..Bin9 → 1..9
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = 1:9
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
  
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    
    strip.text.y = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      size = 12
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      size = 10,
      ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
```
